description: List parts (Artikel): the products and services of the account with Artikelnummer, name, unit, net and gross sales price, purchase price, tax rate, stock (Bestand) and active flag. Filter by part number (Artikelnummer) or name; both filters run in sevDesk, which may match them exactly, so try the full value if a part is missing. Paged: pass nextOffset as offset while hasMore is true. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_part_get for the description and current stock.

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

name: sevdesk_parts_list
title: List sevDesk parts
